## Notes and Links


OSF Website: https://osf.io/  
  
**R-Package** for OSF: [R-osfr](https://docs.ropensci.org/osfr/)  
**Python library** for OSF: [osfclient](https://osfclient.readthedocs.io/en/stable/)  
  
Example **GeoEpi Projects**: https://osf.io/hf8t2/    
  
**VSV SEIR-SEI Model** (Use of DOI example):  
- OSF landing page [HERE](https://osf.io/vqgxs/)  
- DOI Registered on *Data and Code* component [HERE](https://osf.io/rhzu8/)  
     
       
**EpiPlume** (Code interactive use example):    
- OSF Page here [EpiPlume](https://osf.io/98hmt/)    
- Used in rendered script here: [Simulate Outbreak](https://geoepi.github.io/EpiPlume/simulate_outbreak.html)  
- Raw script for above is here: [simulate_outbreak.qmd](https://github.com/geoepi/EpiPlume/blob/main/simulate_outbreak.qmd)  
- An executed model is saved to OSF and read (downloaded) from OSF at this section: [Run Plume Model](https://geoepi.github.io/EpiPlume/simulate_outbreak.html#run-plume-model)  
  
### Other Resources  
OSF on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@CenterforOpenScience   
   
Demo script 1, how to pull data from OSF using **R-osfr** and API: [Pull Data Demo 1](https://github.com/geoepi/sandbox/blob/main/2023-09-06-osf_remote_pull/osf_data_overview.md)  
   
Demo script 2, how to pull data from OSF using **R-osfr** and API.  This one pulls a copy of a publicly available FLAPS dataset from OSF: [Pull Data Demo 2](https://github.com/geoepi/sandbox/blob/main/2024-09-08-osf_geospatial/read_flaps_data.md)
